examples.english: I changed into pajamas and went to bed.

examples.english: The child went outside still wearing pajamas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧パジャマ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In hospitals, you often spend the day in pajamas.

notes:
パジャマ (from English "pajamas") refers to sleepwear, typically a matching top and bottom set.

Related terms:
- ⟦{寝巻|ねまき}→寝巻：00308_nemaki⟧ (traditional nightwear; also includes yukata-style)
- ⟦ルームウェア→ルームウェア：26363_ruumuwea⟧ (loungewear)
- ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ (yukata - also used as sleepwear, especially at ryokan)

Common expressions:
- パジャマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧ (change into pajamas)
- ⟦パジャマパーティー→パジャマパーティー：noentry⟧ (pajama party / sleepover)

Note: Many Japanese ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (traditional inns) provide ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ instead of pajamas.
